comingLast.roast: a high marker holding the blue balls - the honour board salutes the effort
7 points from escape - Bradley has stopped watching his own card
2 to play and the blue balls are already doing warm-down stretches
on 15 with 5 to go - the blue balls can smell the clubhouse
6 to play, 7 to find - the gallery (the bar) is invested
at 1.3 a hole he is on track for the full ceremony
at 1.3 a hole the suspense is entirely one-sided
pace of 1.5 - the blue balls have started their walk to the bar
current run rate 1.5 - the presentation script has him pencilled in
needs 1 in 3 - the kind of chase the bar was built for
